summary: Intake form at Harmony Behavioral Health Center for Carlos M. Rodriguez, a 56-year-old male with Molina Healthcare of Texas Medicaid STAR coverage, referred by Dr. Patricia Nguyen, MD. He reports daily heavy alcohol use (6-8 beers/day) with mild morning tremors, depressed mood, insomnia and irritability for about 8 months since his divorce. He denies suicidal and homicidal ideation; a hunting rifle is kept at his daughter's house. Preliminary diagnoses are alcohol use disorder (moderate), MDD (single episode, moderate) and insomnia. Recommended services are a psychiatric evaluation and individual CBT plus motivational interviewing 2x/week, with IOP to be considered.
